question.text: A photograph of a landscape is captured by a drone camera at a height of 18 km . The size of the camera film is $2 \mathrm{~cm} \times 2 \mathrm{~cm}$ and the area of the landscape photographed is $400 \mathrm{~km}^2$. The focal length of the lens in the drone camera is :

solution.text: $\mathrm{H}=18 \mathrm{~km}$ Size of camera film $=2 \mathrm{~cm} \times 2 \mathrm{~cm}$ $\begin{aligned} & A_{\text {image }}=400 \mathrm{~km}^2 \\ & x=20 \times 10^3 \mathrm{~m}=2 \times 10^4 \mathrm{~m} \\ & y=2 \times 10^{-2} \mathrm{~m} \\ & \frac{x}{y}=10^6=\frac{18 \mathrm{Km}}{\mathrm{f}} \\ & \mathrm{f}=18 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{~m}=18 \mathrm{~mm} \\ & \mathrm{f}=1.8 \mathrm{~cm} \end{aligned}$
